Hand-authored, adjudicated oracle: every entry's expected outcome must equal the decision from tools/role_authority.evaluate_canary(entry) — allowed or refused-with-expected_rule. IDs (role-authority.<class>.<nn>) are stable; never renumber, never repurpose.

Judged frozen: builder drafting under Canonical/corpus/ hits the immutable frozen root.
Judged traversal: leading .. escapes the root and is refused before any root check.
Judged self-promotion: a builder receipt presented for a verifier write cannot authorize it.
Judged stale: receipt head b*40 differs from current head a*40, so the write is blocked.
Judged escalation refused: a verifier-only parent cannot delegate a builder receipt to its child.
Judged refused: an override with an empty scope is vague, never an explicit owner decision.
Control: a fully explicit owner override (owner, decision, scope) is honored, never implicit.
